hook.text: Give away your queen... And checkmate two moves later.

pin.text: Black pins our knight to the queen.

key.text: Knight takes e5... And leaves the queen!

grab.text: Black grabs the queen. Big mistake.

check.text: Bishop takes f7. Check! The king has one square.

mate.text: Knight to d5. Checkmate! Three small pieces beat a queen.

outro.text: A new trap every day. Follow checks mate daily!
